title: Add Phase 2 generated changelog and release manifest
summary: Add generated release documentation, a machine-readable release manifest, release preparation tooling, and stricter change-packet validation.
reason: Phase 2 makes the Phase 1 change-control packets useful for reviewable changelogs and release manifests while keeping release movement and runtime tracking out of scope.
behavior_before: Change packets could be validated and indexed, but the repository did not generate a changelog, release manifest, or release preparation summary from those packets.
behavior_after: Change packets can generate a reviewable changelog and machine-readable release manifest, and prepare_release.py can run the Phase 2 validation and generation sequence without moving changes to released.
manual_validation: Ran refresh_summaries.py for src/mediapipeline/tools/change_control paths successfully.
rollback_plan: Remove Phase 2 scripts and generated files, then keep Phase 1 change packets and validation only.
notes: Phase 2 intentionally does not add runtime audit tables, job-run tracking, UI diagnostics, debug bundle export, database migrations, or media-processing behavior changes.
